category_title: High-achieving dyslexic students using deep-level comprehension strategies
scenario_title: Classroom instruction with heavy reading and note-taking demands
minimal_context: The student is reading an 891-word expository social studies text about socialization, norms, and sanctions to make notes on the most important information before a deadline.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this 891-word text about socialization, norms, and sanctions by yourself and write down notes on the most important information before the deadline.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am trying to read it, but I am getting slowed down by having to cope with the difficult words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep reading and do your best to take notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to make notes on the most important information, but working toward this deadline is making me stressed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to finish reading the text by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I feel that I don’t learn very well from merely reading a text by myself. I think it works just fine to talk about the topics, to discuss them, but doing this alone is too slow.
